name: Bauhaus
summary: Primary-colour geometry, sans-serif lower-case type and strict horizontal and vertical axes with bold diagonals. It came from the Bauhaus school in Weimar, Dessau and Berlin, and it fused craft with industrial production.

philosophy.core_thesis: Form follows function, and a small kit of circle, square and triangle in three primary colours is enough to make any object for mass production.
design_principles: Reduce every composition to the circle, the square and the triangle, and give each shape one primary colour: red, blue or yellow.
Organise the page on strong horizontal and vertical axes, and add diagonals at 45 degrees for tension.
Set type in a geometric sans serif, and use heavy bars of 8px to 24px as structural elements.
Use lower-case lettering for headlines, as in Herbert Bayer's universal alphabet of 1925.
Contrast scale hard: set one element at 5 to 10 times the size of the smallest one.
Use black, white and one primary at a time on a surface, and keep the fields flat and opaque.
Let every element carry information; remove any element that has only a decorative role.
anti_patterns: Ornamental flourishes, scrollwork or revival typefaces
Symmetrical centred layouts with a single axis of balance
Soft gradients, glows and photorealistic textures
Pastel or tertiary colours in place of the three primaries
Rounded decorative containers with a radius above 0px
Serif body text in Fraktur or Didone styles
Random rotation of elements at angles other than 0, 45 and 90 degrees

layout.grid_mechanics: An 8-column grid with 16px gutters and an 8px baseline; blocks align to column edges, and 45-degree diagonals cross at grid intersections.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 30–50% of the surface stays empty; the spacing scale is 8, 16, 32, 64 and 128px.
layout.alignment_rules: Asymmetric balance on strict axes; text lines run flush left or along a 90-degree vertical; headlines may sit on a 45-degree line.
layout.container_geometry: Sharp rectangles, perfect circles and right triangles with a 0px radius on rectangles; bars have a 2:1 to 8:1 aspect ratio.

font_pairings.note: Geometric forms in the manner of Futura and Bayer's Universal.
A single-family setting based on Futura proportions.
A heavy signage face for poster-scale headlines only.

typography.tracking: Display sizes take 0 to +0.02em; body stays at 0; small upper-case labels take +0.1em.
typography.leading: Display 1.0; body 1.5; line-heights are multiples of the 8px baseline.
hierarchy_rules: Use two weights only: regular (400) and bold (700).
Set headlines in lower case, and set one headline word at 5 times the body size.
Underline and tie headlines to the layout with rules of 4px to 8px.
Use red, blue and yellow for emphasis one colour at a time, never together on text.

color.palette_structure: Three primaries plus black and off-white; one primary leads at 15–25% of the surface and the others appear in small blocks.
color.contrast_rules: Body text holds at least 10:1 against paper; yellow carries only black type, at a ratio of 11:1 or more, and never white type.
color.surface_treatment: Flat matte fields of solid colour with a faint paper tone; no gradient and no transparency.
color.light_and_shadow: None. Depth comes only from overlap of flat shapes and from scale contrast.

materiality.surface_simulation: Printed paper and enamelled flat colour; the surface imitates uncoated stock and does not simulate relief.
materiality.border_rules: Solid black rules of 2px to 8px used as structural bars; boxes have either a 4px black outline or no outline.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: No blur and no elevation; box-shadow is none, and overlap carries all depth.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Solid geometric pictograms built from circle, square and triangle, with square terminals and no outline stroke.
ornamentation_details.illustration: Photomontage, abstract compositions of primary shapes and high-contrast photography cropped to rectangles.

motion.transition_physics: Translation for screen: rigid shapes slide and rotate in 90-degree steps along their axes with no bounce and no overshoot.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover swaps the fill to a primary colour with black text; active adds a 4px black bar under the element; nothing scales or glows.

emotion.target_response: Energy with discipline: the viewer feels that the object is deliberate, rational and built for use.

avoid_when: The brand must feel luxurious, soft or ornate.
The product needs long-form reading in dense body text on a coloured field.
The audience expects photorealistic product rendering.

modifiers.how: Drop yellow and blue, keep one red accent under 10% of the surface, and set all text flush left in one neo-grotesque; keep the grid.
Swap the primaries for mustard, teal and orange, add organic shapes with a 50% radius; keep the asymmetric axes.
Raise the bars to 4px black borders and add a hard 6px offset shadow; keep the flat primaries and the 0px radius.
Turn the bars into 1px dividers, use 4px radius buttons filled with one primary; keep the geometric type and the flat fields.

pack.why: Solid forms with square corners and no round terminal: the cut-paper geometry of the workshop.

ground.why: The workshop kit is circle, square and triangle in the three primaries, with one black bar for direction.
